definition.name: Restore Schedule Filters From Source Model
definition.description: Re-creates the filters of same-named schedules from a named source model on schedules in a named target model, mapping level filters by level name.
definition.aiDescription: Re-creates the filters of same-named schedules from a named source model on schedules in a named target model, mapping level filters by level name.
examples: restore the filters of these schedules from the same schedules in another open model
